Introduction

i-dle, formerly known as (G)I-DLE, is a South Korean multi-national girl group under Cube Entertainment. The group consists of five members: Miyeon, Minnie, Soyeon, Yuqi, and Shuhua. They debuted on May 2nd, 2018 with their debut mini-album "I am", and its title track "LATATA".

Debuting as a six-member group, they were quickly dubbed “Monster Rookies” by the media after achieving remarkable success in their first year—securing six music show wins and collecting twelve year-end awards.

Cube Entertainment announced Soojin’s departure on August 14, 2021. The agency apologized for the controversy involving their artist Soojin, who had been on hiatus since March due to accusations of bullying her schoolmates. Following Soojin's departure in August 2021, i-dle returned as a five-member group with their first studio album “I Never Die” on March 14, 2022.

During the Melon Music Awards in November 2024, Soyeon announced in their Record of the Year (Daesang) acceptance speech that all five members had decided to renew their contracts with Cube Entertainment just before arriving at the ceremony. The group officially rebranded to i-dle on May 2, 2025 to celebrate the group's seventh anniversary.
